subject: Business Models
title: Subsidize One Side
description: A fast breakdown of Subsidize One Side for builders.

hook.text: Uber gave riders $20 credit and drivers guaranteed hourly pay. It literally bought both sides.

buildup.text: Most platforms subsidize the harder side to attract. Once that side joins, the other follows.

discovery.text: Adobe gave away the PDF reader free while charging for the creator. Free readers drove paid creators.

twist.text: Subsidies burn cash fast. Uber lost $31 billion before turning profitable in 2023.

climax.text: Subsidies are temporary bridges. If value doesn't appear by the time subsidies end, the platform dies.

punchline.text: Pay one side, attract the other, then stop paying. If you can.

quiz.question: How much did Uber lose before reaching profitability?
